toolPurpose: Search across the connected Notion workspace for sprint boards, backlog databases, active sprint pages, retrospective notes, blocker logs, and standup records. Useful for discovering the right scrum artifacts before querying or updating them.

query.description: Free-text search query for locating scrum boards, sprint pages, stories, blockers, or retro notes

sort.description: Optional sort configuration for search results

filter.description: Optional result filter to narrow results to pages or databases

start_cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous search response

toolPurpose: Query a Notion database used as a scrum board or backlog. Filter stories by sprint, status, assignee, priority, blocked state, or stale-card conditions to drive standups, sprint planning, velocity checks, and WIP analysis.

database_id.description: The Notion database ID for the sprint board, backlog, or retrospective tracker

filter.description: Notion database query filter object for status, sprint, assignee, points, blocker flags, dates, or other board properties

sorts.description: Sort rules for ordering results such as priority, status, or last edited time

start_cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous query response

filter_properties.description: Optional list of property IDs to limit the properties returned for each card

toolPurpose: Retrieve a specific scrum card or page in Notion, including its current properties, timestamps, and metadata. Useful for inspecting a story before moving it, checking blocker details, or reviewing sprint item state.

page_id.description: The Notion page ID for the story, task, bug, or sprint artifact to retrieve

filter_properties.description: Optional list of property IDs to include in the response

toolPurpose: Update a scrum page or card in Notion. WRITE operation — requires explicit Mind confirmation before execution. Use this to change story status, assignee, sprint assignment, story points, due dates, blocker flags, archive state, or other page properties that drive scrum workflows.

page_id.description: The Notion page ID for the story, task, or sprint artifact to update

properties.description: Notion page property updates such as status, assignee, sprint, points, priority, blocked, or target date

is_locked.description: Whether to lock the page in the Notion UI

toolPurpose: Move a scrum card across kanban columns or workflow stages by updating the page that represents the card. WRITE operation — requires explicit Mind confirmation before execution. Use this for backlog-to-sprint pulls, In Progress transitions, review handoffs, Done moves, and blocker lane updates.

page_id.description: The Notion page ID for the card being moved

status_property.description: The name of the status or select property that controls the board column

target_status.description: The destination column or workflow state, such as Backlog, In Progress, Review, Blocked, or Done

properties.description: Optional additional page property updates to apply alongside the move, such as assignee or sprint

toolPurpose: Append content blocks to a page or block in Notion. WRITE operation — requires explicit Mind confirmation before execution. Use this to add standup notes, retrospective action items, blocker updates, acceptance checklists, or sprint summaries to existing scrum documents.

block_id.description: The Notion block ID whose children should receive the new content

children.description: Array of Notion block objects to append, such as paragraphs, bulleted lists, to-dos, or headings

after.description: Optional block ID after which the new children should be inserted

toolPurpose: Update an existing Notion block that holds scrum content. WRITE operation — requires explicit Mind confirmation before execution. Use this to revise standup prompts, retro bullets, checklist items, blocker descriptions, or sprint narrative text without replacing the full page.

block_id.description: The Notion block ID to update

type.description: The Notion block type being updated, such as paragraph, heading_2, bulleted_list_item, or to_do

block_payload.description: The block-type-specific payload containing the updated content

toolPurpose: Update the schema or metadata of a Notion database used as a scrum board. WRITE operation — requires explicit Mind confirmation before execution. Use this to rename board views, adjust property definitions, add sprint-related fields, or tune metadata that supports planning and reporting workflows.

database_id.description: The Notion database ID for the scrum board or backlog to update

title.description: Optional rich-text title for the database

description.description: Optional rich-text description for the database

properties.description: Database property schema updates such as adding or modifying sprint, points, status, owner, or blocker-related fields

is_inline.description: Whether the database should be displayed inline in Notion

toolPurpose: List comments attached to a sprint card or page in Notion. Useful for detecting blockers, reading reviewer feedback, collecting standup context, and surfacing unresolved discussion on active work items.

block_id.description: The page or block ID whose comments should be retrieved

start_cursor.description: Pagination cursor from a previous comments response

toolPurpose: Retrieve the identity of the currently authenticated Notion user or bot. Useful for confirming the connected workspace context before running sprint-board reads or writes.
